items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Him and Cantrell, well, I even learned how to

ctx.x: He was one of the last drummers, up until about two or three years ago. He had a stroke, but he's still living in, seems to get along all right.

Well, these fellas was about, his master's, he was about one of the best drummers in our lives. Oh, yeah. Him and Cantrell, well, I even learned how to, I ain't got them sticks now, but I can take them sticks and beat them up in there, just like that.
Oh, yeah, I've seen Chinese do that too.
